use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES

use Math = System.Math
use Point = (x: double, y: double)

union Half(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) is
    THIN(..)
    FAT(..)
si

let phi = (1.0D + Math.sqrt(5.0D)) / 2.0D

towards(from: Point, to: Point) -> Point =>
    (x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) / phi,
     y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) / phi)

split(tile: Half) -> Pipe[Half] is
    if isa Half.THIN(tile) then
        let cut = towards(tile.a, tile.b)

        yield Half.THIN(tile.c, cut, tile.b)
        yield Half.FAT(cut, tile.c, tile.a)
    else
        let near = towards(tile.b, tile.a)
        let far = towards(tile.b, tile.c)

        yield Half.FAT(far, tile.c, tile.a)
        yield Half.FAT(near, far, tile.b)
        yield Half.THIN(far, near, tile.a)
    fi
si

spoke(index: int) -> Half =>
    (let low = cast double(2 * index - 1) * Math.pi / 10.0D
     let high = cast double(2 * index + 1) * Math.pi / 10.0D

     let first = (x = Math.cos(low), y = Math.sin(low))
     let second = (x = Math.cos(high), y = Math.sin(high))
     let middle = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D)

     if index % 2 == 0 then
         Half.THIN(middle, second, first)
     else
         Half.THIN(middle, first, second)
     fi)

let tiles mut = (0..10) |> map(spoke) |> collect_list()

for _ in 0..6 do
    tiles = tiles |> flat_map(split) |> collect_list()
od

let image = IMAGE(660, 440)

image.view(-0.62D, -0.4133D, 0.62D, 0.4133D)
image.stroke(1.0D)

let shapes = SHAPES()

for tile in tiles do
    if isa Half.FAT(tile) then
        shapes.add([tile.a, tile.b, tile.c], 232ub, 184ub, 118ub)
    else
        shapes.add([tile.a, tile.b, tile.c], 118ub, 164ub, 214ub)
    fi
od

image.fill(shapes)

image.colour(60ub, 60ub, 70ub)

for tile in tiles do
    image.line([tile.c, tile.a, tile.b])
od

image.write("penrose.png")

image.show("penrose.png")
